sections.title: Date and Time of Discharge
sections.promptHint: Doctor enters manually when starting the draft; DisDate in the system is empty until the hospital finalizes discharge.

sections.title: Diagnosis
sections.promptHint: List the primary surgical diagnosis first, then secondaries including relevant comorbidities. Use exact clinical wording; do not add or reclassify.

sections.title: Presenting Complaints
sections.promptHint: Summarize distinct complaints of type 'Chief Complaint' only. Collapse repeated rows with the same complaint into one clean line, adding the recorded date or date range when useful. Do not include associated complaints or dump raw rows. Return one item per line; do not leave an escaped-newline marker visible in the text.

sections.title: History of Present Illness
sections.promptHint: Write a concise chronological History of Present Illness using the chief complaints plus associated complaints and recorded remarks, emphasizing symptom evolution relevant to surgical decision-making. Group repeated symptoms rather than listing every row. Return 2-4 useful lines separated by real line breaks. Use only this recorded proxy, do not invent detail, and do not replace the narrative with a disclaimer. Add at most one short review caveat at the end if needed.

sections.title: Past Medical History
sections.promptHint: Summarize the distinct recorded problems as a concise Past Medical History, including status and onset and noting comorbidities relevant to surgical risk when present. Use one problem per line, do not invent or reclassify conditions, and add at most one short review caveat at the end if needed.

sections.title: Current Medication
sections.promptHint: List active medications using only medication name, recorded schedule, start date, and stop date. Use one medication per line, note anticoagulants/antiplatelets where recorded, omit status, and do not invent dose or route.

sections.title: Personal History
sections.promptHint: No source in the API. Leave blank for the doctor; never invent smoking history or other surgical risk factors.

sections.title: Family History
sections.promptHint: No source in the API. Leave blank for the doctor; never invent family history.

sections.title: Allergies
sections.promptHint: List each allergen with reaction nature and symptoms — drug allergies matter for perioperative prescribing — or state the recorded status (e.g. NKA).

sections.title: Occupational History
sections.promptHint: No source in the API. Leave blank for the doctor; never invent occupational detail.

sections.title: On Examination
sections.promptHint: Most recent vitals only; state explicitly this covers recorded vitals, not a cardiorespiratory or peripheral-vascular examination. Do not invent exam findings.

sections.title: Course in Hospital
sections.promptHint: Synthesize notes, labs, radiology, medication changes, and the vitals trend into 3-6 concise chronological lines separated by real line breaks. Emphasize recorded perioperative changes, post-op vitals, transfusions, or antibiotic courses. Do not reproduce raw lists or a medication list here; do not invent intra-operative detail beyond the doctor's Procedure field.

sections.title: Condition at Discharge
sections.promptHint: Most recent vitals plus current status of active problems, including wound- or post-op-related problems where recorded. Report recorded values only.

sections.title: Procedure
sections.promptHint: No procedures or OT record endpoint exists. The surgeon must document the procedure performed manually; this is a required field — approval is blocked while it is empty. The generator must not write this section.

sections.title: Medications During Stay
sections.promptHint: List medications ordered during this episode using one line per medication with only medication name, recorded schedule, start date, and stop date. Include completed or discontinued perioperative orders when recorded, but omit status and raw JSON.

sections.title: Medications on Discharge
sections.promptHint: Draft a concise medication-on-discharge list using only discharge-suitable active medication orders and the recorded surgical diagnoses as context. Exclude injections, IV/infusion/chemotherapy, inpatient-only supplies, and any medication not present in the orders. Use medication name, schedule, start date, and stop date; omit status and do not invent replacements.

sections.title: Advice
sections.promptHint: Draft short patient-specific advice from explicit advice, restrictions, precautions, wound-care instructions, or activity instructions in progress/discharge notes, using diagnoses only as context. If notes lack explicit advice, provide only a concise diagnosis-grounded draft for doctor review; do not invent restrictions or doses.

sections.title: Special Needs
sections.promptHint: No source in the API. Leave blank for the doctor; never invent care needs.

sections.title: Follow Up Advice
sections.promptHint: Draft brief surgical follow-up advice grounded primarily in the recorded diagnoses and any explicit follow-up instructions in notes. Do not invent a clinic, interval, test, or treatment change; keep it useful and for doctor review.
